quickSwitchTimeout.name: Quick Switch Timeout (ms)
quickSwitchTimeout.description: Timeout to distinguish a quick Alt+Tab toggle from the full task switcher
quickSwitchTimeout.description[zh_CN]: 区分快速 Alt+Tab 切换与完整任务切换器的超时时长

forceSoftwareCursor.name: Force Software Cursor
forceSoftwareCursor.description[zh_CN]: 强制使用软光标进行渲染

enablePrelaunchSplash.name: Enable Prelaunch Splash
enablePrelaunchSplash.description: Enable showing prelaunch splash screens during application startup
enablePrelaunchSplash.description[zh_CN]: 启用应用程序启动期间显示预启动闪屏服务

prelaunchSplashTimeoutMs.name: Prelaunch Splash Timeout (ms)
prelaunchSplashTimeoutMs.description: Timeout before destroying unmatched prelaunch splash wrappers
prelaunchSplashTimeoutMs.description[zh_CN]: 在未匹配到窗口时销毁预启动闪屏的超时时长

remoteDebug.name: Allow Debugging
remoteDebug.description: Allow debugging tools to connect. Release builds only let root connect. While this is on, treeland publishes its debug socket and serves the window tree remote source on demand, collecting everything per call (the only session-scoped resource, input-event capture, is armed only while a client polls for events). Turn it off to forbid debugging entirely.
remoteDebug.description[zh_CN]: 允许调试工具连接。Release 构建仅允许 root 连接。开启时 treeland 会发布调试 socket，窗口树远程源按需提供服务、数据在每次调用时现场采集（唯一的会话级资源是输入事件捕获，只在客户端轮询事件时才挂上）；关闭则完全禁止调试。

showOtherUserOption.name: Show Other User Option
showOtherUserOption.description: Show the 'Other...' entry in the login user list to allow logging in as an unlisted (e.g. LDAP/NSS) user
showOtherUserOption.description[zh_CN]: 在登录用户列表中显示 Other... 选项，允许以未列出的用户（如 LDAP/NSS 用户）登录

primaryOutputId.name: Primary Output ID
primaryOutputId.description: Output id recorded as the primary output. Empty means no primary output has been saved.
primaryOutputId.description[zh_CN]: 记录为主屏幕的输出 ID。空字符串表示未保存主屏幕。

keyboardNumLock.name: Keyboard Num Lock
keyboardNumLock.description: Whether the Num Lock state is enabled by default on keyboards that have a numeric keypad. When enabled, the numeric keypad inputs numbers.
keyboardNumLock.description[zh_CN]: 是否默认在带有数字小键盘的键盘上启用数字锁定。启用时数字小键盘输入数字。

singleOutputId.name: Single Output ID
singleOutputId.description: Output ID used for single-output display. Empty means multiple outputs may be enabled. This selection is independent of copy and extension mode.
singleOutputId.description[zh_CN]: 单屏显示时使用的输出 ID。空字符串表示可启用多个输出。此选择与复制和扩展模式相互独立。

outputGroups.name: Output Groups
outputGroups.description: JSON string array of persisted output group names.
outputGroups.description[zh_CN]: 持久化的输出分组名称的 JSON 字符串数组。

outputGroupSource.name: Output Group Source UUID
outputGroupSource.name[zh_CN]: 输出分组的源输出 UUID
outputGroupSource.description: Configured source output uuid of one output group. Stored under the group name subpath.
outputGroupSource.description[zh_CN]: 某个输出分组的配置源输出 uuid。存放于以分组名为名的子路径下。

outputGroupMirrors.name: Output Group Mirror UUIDs
outputGroupMirrors.name[zh_CN]: 输出分组的镜像输出 UUID 队列
outputGroupMirrors.description: JSON string array of configured mirror output uuids of one output group, in list order.
outputGroupMirrors.description[zh_CN]: 某个输出分组配置的镜像输出 uuid 的 JSON 字符串数组，按列表顺序。

prelaunchSplashMaxMismatchCount.name: Prelaunch Splash Max Mismatch Count
prelaunchSplashMaxMismatchCount.name[zh_CN]: 预启动闪屏最大不匹配次数
prelaunchSplashMaxMismatchCount.description: Maximum consecutive splash match failures before disabling splash for an app. 0 means never auto-disable.
prelaunchSplashMaxMismatchCount.description[zh_CN]: 连续闪屏匹配失败达到此次数后禁用该应用的闪屏功能。0 表示永不自动禁用。
